effects.description: [Activate: Main] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and this Character: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters -1000 power during this turn.
conditions: You have at least 1 DON!! card you can rest
Your opponent has at least 1 Character on the field
steps: (Optional) Rest 1 DON!! card and this Character to activate the effect
Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Characters
That Character gets -1000 power during this turn
notes: You can choose not to use this effect even if all conditions are met
The power reduction lasts until the end of this turn
This effect can only be used during your Main Phase
